hardware.variant: CIX P1 CD8180; 32 GB; stock BiosV1.5-W20260706-e321056a; no RTC backup battery

inputs.name: EmberBSD Wi-Fi trial kernel that set the time
EmberBSD kernel EMBER64_CIX_PERIPHERALS that read the time

scenario: With no battery on the RTC connector, set the system time with date(1). Shut down with a short press of the power button. Remove input power for a few seconds, restore it, and boot.
expected: The kernel reads a time within one second of a reference clock and reports no lost clock.
observed: The kernel printed 'WARNING: clock lost 1838 days': the RTC time was 1838 days behind the file system time. The kernel used the file system time. After boot, the board clock was 45.9 s behind the reference host. An earlier boot after a power interruption of unknown cause printed 'clock lost 1831 days'.
limits: One controlled cycle. The length of the power removal was not recorded.
The earlier pass in efi-rtc-power-removal had the same battery state. The cause of the different result is unknown.
The Wi-Fi trial kernel set the time, and the RTC was not read back before the power removal. The boot of that kernel already printed 'clock lost 1838 days'.
The configuration name and image hash of the Wi-Fi trial kernel were not recorded.
Retention with a backup battery is not tested.
